description: The WORKS prop set — the industry/infrastructure vocabulary the audit's §5.4 requires every works place type to be described in (`shipyard`, `salt-pans`, `paddy-works`, `clay-pit-and-kiln`, `portage-slipway`, `bog-iron-bloomery`, `works-town`, `crystal-diggings`, `boatwright-yard`). There is no kiln, saltern, sluice-gate, winding-gear or hull-on-stocks mesh anywhere in the vault and none can be sourced, so this kit packages the vanilla pieces those descriptions must be built from: the blacksmith set (forge, workbench, bellows, sharpening wheel), the smelter and its coal (READ AS the kiln), tanning and drying and fish racks, hand/vendor carts and wheels, firewood stacks, the mine timber family (beams, planks, scaffold supports) and ore faces, the full stockade scaffold family (bases, tops, ramp, stairs, bridges, posts) for slipways/stocks/staging, the lumbermill WATER WHEELS, the farmhouse walkway gate boards (the only vanilla piece that reads as a SLUICE gate), dock steps/entry, and salt/basket/barrel/crate/sack/bucket/pitchfork/shovel/trough dressing for salt-pan and paddy terrain (the pans and bunds themselves are compiler-authored terrain and water, not meshes). Mud Mother Grove adds the Argonian fish rack, carapace oven, clay oven, baskets, urn and woven/snake fences so a works site reads Argonian. TROPICALISED: vanilla-backed textures resolve through Tropical Skyrim (vanilla filenames, texture-only — it ships no architecture meshes), so the vanilla-backed pieces read hot and wet instead of Nordic grey. That is the PIPELINE DEFAULT for every kit since 2026-09-09, not a key this config sets; a kit keeps the un-tropicalised vanilla art only by declaring `untropicalisedReason`. `clutter/stockade` is not covered by Tropical and uses the same textureAliases redirect as settlement-stilt-v1. Gap G3 (a nailed notice/licence board readable at arm's length — tapping licences, nailed price lists, toll posts and register boards) is closed by BM&V's `advertising_board`: a freestanding roofed notice pane 1.56 × 1.39 × 2.47 m whose posted papers are part of the authored mesh (`infopanel_papers`), so no paper piece has to be jammed onto it.

fx:smoke-column.why: The puff atlas vanilla's chimney smoke particle system (mps/mpssmokechimney01.nif, the addon node of effects/ambient/fxsmokechimney01.nif) draws; game-core settlement/smokeColumn.ts billboards it.

fx:candleflame01.why: MPSCandleFlame01's CandleFlame01 particle (Skyrim.esm ADDN 49, the AddOnNode49 of every vanilla and Mud Mother candle and lantern): a 2x2 atlas of four flames, one cell per particle (build_kit mine_fire_layer). Also the fallback flame over a fixture whose NIF holds no flame (lighting.ts).

fx:fxfireatlas02-gradfireexplosion.why: campfire01burning's FlamesSmall03 particle system: greyscale 4x2 flame atlas baked through its palette (build_kit bake_palette).

fx:fxfirecolumnanimloop-gradfireexplosio.why: campfire01burning's Firearticles particle system: the 8x8 flame-column loop its BSPSysSubTexModifier plays over the particle's life, baked through its palette.

fx:fxfireatlas04-gradflame01.why: The torch flame (torchsconce01 pFireballCore04, MPSTorchFire01 = ADDN 46): greyscale 1x8 atlas baked through its palette.

fx:glowslightflash.why: The billboard glow disc of campfire01burning (Glow02) and fxfirewithembers01 (glow): drawn as a camera-facing additive sprite, never a fixed card (build_kit apply_fire_layer).

fx:fxglowwhite01.why: torchsconce01's billboard GlowMesh (interior-farmhouse-v1): drawn as a camera-facing additive sprite.

fx:glowsoft01.why: The billboard GlowMesh07 of the Ayleid evil welkynd cluster (ayleidcc arwelkyndclusterevil01, xanmeer-interior-v1): a camera-facing additive sprite in the NIF's own emissive red (glow record tintRgb).

textureAliasReasons.textures/\bERR: vanilla clutter/blacksmith/blacksmithforge01.nif `Shading.Mat` (BSLightingShaderProperty, DECAL + vertex colours: the soot shading over the forge's floor stones) names the broken diffuse `\x08ERR` (4 bytes, no folder, no .dds; its normal slot is `\x08NOR`). The forge's own texture in the same vanilla folder (textures/clutter/blacksmith/ holds anvil, bellows, forge01, novice*, sharpeningwheel, stone, workbench*) is blacksmithforge01.dds, which the same NIF's L2_FloorStones.Mat already UVs, so the decal takes it (16k fix 2 round 5 ruling 6: resolve, never drop).
textureAliasReasons.textures/_resourcepack/landscape/trees/b: King of the Murkmire's beehive (kotm:argonia/clutter/beehive, the Argonian hive the walk-9 dressing lane placed at Greenspring) is barked in the AE _ResourcePack baldcypressbark01_d, an archive the vault lacks; it takes KotM's own LOD copy of that bark exactly as interior-kotm-v1's alias row does (its textureNote, walk 5). The vanilla beehive01 was rejected: it is the burnable Goldenglow hive, whose NIF carries its burning state (AddOnNode04 -> MPSFireWallSparks, PFlames emitters and flame cards toggled by its behaviour graph), so the fire layer mines a fire onto it.

snapLogic.grid: None — these are freestanding props, not a tileset. Placement is by hand/compiler rule against the site, not by connector.
snapLogic.stockade-scaffold: The one family here that DOES snap, in vanilla's own logic: a `stockadescaffoldbase<n>sided01` footing carries a `stockadescaffoldtop<n>sided01` deck of the matching side count (`n` = how many faces are railed), joined between decks by `bridge01/02`/`bridgenarrow`, climbed by `ramp01` or `stairs01`, and propped by `basesupport01` and `toppost01/02`. Keep side counts consistent around a platform or railings gap.
snapLogic.mine-timbers: `minewoodbeam01-03` + `minewoodbeamshort01/02` + `minewoodplanks01-04` are vanilla's shoring vocabulary and are placed as a repeating rib along a tunnel or trench; `minescaffoldsupport01`/`minescaffoldbasesupport01(w)` are the vertical props.
snapLogic.reads: Documented substitutions this kit is the answer to: kiln = `smelter01` + `smelter01coal01` + firewood stacks + drying racks; sluice gate = `walkwaycwallgate01/02` set in a compiler-cut channel; slipway/hull-on-stocks = stockade scaffold + `minewoodbeam` rollers + dock steps, with an SBoT hull raised on them (hull comes from the boat pools, not this kit); winding gear = mine scaffold and a shored tunnel mouth; saltern = terrain pans dressed with `saltpile`, baskets, rakes (`pitchfork01`), `shovel01` and a `horsetrough01` store; water-wheel works = `lumbermill01waterwheel01/02`.
snapLogic.unitScale: Bethesda units; 0.0142240 m/unit. Measured extents in works-v1.kit.json.
snapLogic.notice-board: `bmv:advertising_board` is freestanding and self-supporting (two posts, shingled roof, papers nailed to the pane by its author). Place it standing on its own base, pane facing the approach, at the head of a quay, stage rail or toll post; never mount it on a wall or fuse it to a rail — nothing authored it to snap. Pane centre sits ~1.6 m up, i.e. eye height, which is what makes it readable at arm's length.
snapLogic.assemblies: Composites in this kit: `composite:works/stockade-scaffold-2stage` and `-3stage` freeze the one rule the vanilla scaffold family actually has — a base carries the next stage 2.73 m above itself, unrotated (template vanilla:t0019, 28 placements). Nothing else here is composited: bridges, ramps, stairs and props join platforms, and what they join is a site decision. Every single piece stays in the kit.
snapLogic.fire: `campfire01burning` is vanilla's lit campfire: logs, ash and stones with its ember and flame-glow cards (effect shaders). Its config sets `"effect": "additive"`, so those cards export see-through (glTF BLEND, material extra `additive: true`, manifest `additiveMaterials`) and its heat-shimmer plane (a refraction-only quad) is dropped; vanilla's flame particles are not imported. `cookingstand01` (a pot stand) and `spit01` (a spit frame) stand over it; `impbrazier01` is a low brazier bowl, cold (its flame in vanilla is the separate FXFireWithEmbers01 effect). The campfire and the brazier carry a `light` block in their manifest record: the Skyrim LIGH record the plugin places with them (LightCampFire01, DefaultTorch01NS), in the carriedLight `LightRecord` shape plus `offsetM` (glTF Y-up metres from the pivot) and the evidence. The settlement runtime turns it into a point light (game-core settlement/lighting.ts); `fixtureKind` campfire and brazier mark fires that burn by day too (planner ruling, walk 2).
snapLogic.smoke-and-flame: Added 16k fix round 2: `effects/fxfirewithembers01` (MSTT FXFireWithEmbers01) is the flame vanilla stands in `impbrazier01` (105 of 262 brazier refs): its flame and coal cards import as `"effect": "additive"`, its refraction plane is dropped and its ember particle systems are not imported (PyNifly imports no NiParticleSystem). Chimney smoke is NOT here: `effects/ambient/fxsmokechimney01`/`02` hold only an editor-marker shape and a BSValueNode naming an addon-node particle effect, so the kit build yields a marker and no smoke; they stay registered for a runtime particle effect.
snapLogic.road-sign: `roadsignpost` is vanilla's bare road-sign post (0.26 x 0.24 x 3.64 m; plugin: every directional board in Skyrim hangs on it, sourcing log § signs on posts). The boards are BM&V's six BLANK boards `roadsign{small,medium,large}01{l,r}` (left- and right-pointing), which are Hanaisse's Blank Roadsigns resource (Nexus skyrim 33392) made for nailing to any vanilla signpost; their `textures/hana/signs/*` come from that resource (the bmv pool's texture sibling, 16k fix round 2), so they ship unlettered. No mined pair hangs them on `roadsignpost` yet.
snapLogic.dressing-2026-09-26: Landing and hut-yard dressing added 2026-09-26 (16k kits lane 2), all plain ground-standers: `shores:shoresofskyrim/fishnet01` (a coiled fishing net, Shores of Skyrim), the cook pots `spitpotopen01` (hangs from `cookingstand01`'s hook), `spitpotopenloose01` and `kitchen/castironpotmedium01` (vanilla), `kotm:argonia/clutter/saxhleelmetalpot01` (King of the Murkmire), and baskets `basket05`, `basket06` (vanilla), `kotm:argonia/clutter/basket01`, `basket02` and `basketcontainer` (a lidded storage jar-basket).

compose.note: Vanilla's stockade scaffold, two stages. Template vanilla:t0019 (28 placements): a `stockadescaffoldbase4sided01` footing carries the next identical stage exactly 2.73 m above itself, unrotated. That is the same rule this kit's `stockade-scaffold` prose states in words, measured. The bridges, ramps, stairs and props stay separate placements: what they join is a site decision, not a module.

The same 2.73 m stage rule (vanilla:t0019, 28 placements) run to three stages, ~8.2 m of staging in one parcel, three bases and no deck: the composite carries no top plate (16h K10 audit). A deck goes on as its own placement, `stockadescaffoldtop0sided01` 2.72 m above the head base, as the plugin puts it on a 4-sided base (vanilla:t0474, 7 placements; vanilla:t0061 is the same plate on the 0-sided base). Used where a slipway or hull-on-stocks needs height rather than footprint.
